external.emptyDescription: Connect a platform to start receiving messages.
external.connectPlatformDescription: Connect your business messaging accounts to receive and respond to customer inquiries directly in Oikion.
external.adminAccessNote: You will need admin access to your business account on the platform you want to connect.

platformDescriptions.viber: Connect your Viber bot to receive chats.
platformDescriptions.whatsapp: Connect WhatsApp Business to reply from Oikion.
platformDescriptions.messenger: Connect a Facebook Page to receive Messenger chats.

viber.title: Connect Viber
viber.description: Paste your Viber bot token to complete setup.
viber.step1Description: You will need to create a business bot account on Viber's platform first.
viber.step1Instruction1Body: Go to partners.viber.com and sign in
viber.step1Instruction2Body: Click "Create Bot Account" and fill in your business details
viber.step1Instruction3Body: After approval you will receive an authentication token – keep it ready for the next step
viber.step2Hint: This is the token you received from Viber Partners
viber.step3SettingUp: Setting up webhook connection... This will take a few seconds.
viber.successDescription: Your Viber bot is now connected to Oikion. Customer messages will appear in the External tab.
viber.successNotifications: You will receive notifications for new messages

whatsapp.title: Connect WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Add your WhatsApp Business access token and phone details.
whatsapp.preConnectionSubtitle: The most popular messaging platform worldwide
whatsapp.whatYouNeed2: A phone number for your WhatsApp Business
whatsapp.whatYouNeed3: Admin access to your Facebook Business Manager
whatsapp.howItWorks1: You'll sign in with Facebook and select your business
whatsapp.howItWorks2: Choose which phone number to connect
whatsapp.howItWorks3: We'll handle the technical setup automatically
whatsapp.howItWorks4: Start receiving customer messages in Oikion
whatsapp.connectingSubtitle: Setting up your WhatsApp Business connection
whatsapp.successDescription: Your WhatsApp Business account is now connected to Oikion
whatsapp.successNote: Customer messages will now appear in your External messages tab. You can reply directly from Oikion.

messenger.title: Connect Messenger
messenger.description: Use your Page access token to complete setup.
messenger.whatYouNeed1: A Facebook Page for your business
messenger.howItWorks1: Sign in with Facebook and select your Page
messenger.howItWorks3: We'll set up the connection automatically
messenger.pageNote: You'll need to select a Facebook Page during the connection process. If you don't have a Page yet, you can create one at facebook.com/pages/create
messenger.successDescription: Your Facebook Page is now connected to Oikion
messenger.successNote: Messages from your Facebook Page will now appear in the External tab. Reply to customers directly from Oikion.

help.title: Connection help
help.issue1Title: I don't see my phone number or page
help.issue1Body: Make sure you have admin access to the business account or page you're trying to connect.
help.issue1Bullet1: Check your role in Facebook Business Manager
help.issue1Bullet2: Verify the phone number is verified in WhatsApp Manager
help.issue1Bullet3: Try logging out and back into Facebook
help.issue2Body: This usually happens due to temporary network issues or Facebook's servers being busy.
help.issue2Bullet1: Wait a few minutes and try again
help.issue2Bullet3: Clear your browser cache and cookies
help.issue3BodyViber: For Viber: Make sure you copied the entire token without any extra spaces.
help.issue3BodyMeta: For WhatsApp/Messenger: Try disconnecting and reconnecting your Facebook account.
help.contactSupport: Still having issues? Contact our support team at support@oikion.gr
help.whatsappReq3: Admin access to WhatsApp Business Account
help.messengerReq3: Page must be published (not in draft)

conversation.selectDescription: Choose a channel or direct message from the sidebar to start chatting with your team.
conversation.unableToConnect: Unable to connect to messaging service

composer.sendHint: Press Enter to send, Shift + Enter for new line

channels.createDescription: Channels are where your team communicates. They're best organized around a topic — #marketing, for example.
channels.name: Channel name
channels.typePublicDescription: Anyone in the organization can join
channels.typePrivateDescription: Only invited members can see and join
channels.typeAnnouncementDescription: Only admins can post, everyone can read
channels.archiveConfirm: Are you sure you want to archive this channel? Members will no longer be able to send messages.
channels.defaultDescription: New members automatically join this channel

empty.createFirst: Create your first channel to get started
